notes.subject: Babel
notes.rationale: Direct apostrophe — the psalmist addresses Babylon personified as 'daughter of Babylon'.

notes.subject: pikinini meri bilong Babel
notes.rationale: Hebrew idiom 'daughter of X' for a city and its people, rendered literally.

notes.subject: השדודה
notes.rationale: 'The destroyed/despised one' — KJV 'who art to be destroyed' (future) vs YLT 'O destroyed one' (already devastated).

translation: Pikinini meri bilong Babel, ol i bagarapim yu — gutpela tumas long man i bai payim yu bek ⟨את⟩ long ol pasin yu wokim long mipela.

tokens.gloss: man i bai payim yu bek

tokens.marks: ol pasin yu wokim long mipela
